description: This file defines the React component 'RemotionRoot' which sets up multiple 'Composition' components for use within the Remotion animation framework. It imports other components and schemas, and specifies various compositions with their properties such as ID, component, duration, frame rate, size, and default props.

methods.name: RemotionRoot
methods.description: Functional React component that returns multiple Composition components to define different video compositions for Remotion.
